title: CompanyHistory
description: Shape of data/company-history.json — one count of open published jobs per company per UTC day, written by scripts/build_data_readme.py (update_company_history) so a /company page can draw a real 'open roles over time' line for EVERY company, not just the 20 that fit stats-history.json's top_companies. 'days' is the ascending list of UTC dates a snapshot was taken (the last run of a day wins); 'companies' maps the company name exactly as it appears in site-index.json to an array of integer counts aligned index-for-index with 'days'. A company absent from a recorded day has count 0 (site-index.json is the complete published set, so absence is a real zero, never a gap). History starts the day this file was first written — there is deliberately NO backfill from stats-history.json, whose top-20 cap would turn 'fell out of the top 20' into a fake zero. A company whose every count is 0 is dropped. Capped to the last retention_days days.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the run that last wrote this file

retention_days.description: How many days of history are kept (same as stats-history.json: 90)

days.description: Ascending UTC dates (YYYY-MM-DD) with a recorded snapshot

companies.description: company name -> array of non-negative integer counts, one per entry in 'days'
